welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.headline:
Your Tax Paddy,
Built for Nigeria
welcome.subheadline: We go help you do VAT, CIT, TIN and e-invoice. No wahala!
welcome.termsNote: If you continue, e mean say you agree to our Terms of Service
welcome.featureTitle: Tax waka wey work for Nigeria
welcome.featureBody: Security onboarding, offline saving, and tax guidance wey fit Nigerian businesses.

setup.title: Guided setup wey clear
setup.body: We go explain each tax step for simple language so you know wetin dey urgent and wetin fit wait.

offline.title: Built for bad network
offline.body: Your progress go save for phone first, then sync later when network come back.

deadlines.title: Deadline wey match your business
deadlines.body: Your answers go turn to clear VAT, WHT, CIT, and e-invoice next steps for dashboard.

businessType.title:
Tell Us About
Your Business
businessType.subtitle: We go arrange your tax obligations based on your business type.

descriptions.sole_trader: Good for one-person business and freelance work wey use personal tax rules.
descriptions.partnership: For business wey partners dey share profit and responsibility together.
descriptions.limited_company: For registered company wey need company tax guidance and annual filing support.
descriptions.ngo: For mission work, association, and non-profit wey still need clean compliance record.

tinVerify.title: Enter Your TIN
tinVerify.body: Without TIN, dem fit cut 10% from all the money wey you collect. Enter am quick quick.
tinVerify.nrsNote: NRS (Nigeria Revenue Service, before dem call am FIRS) dey manage am
tinVerify.pendingNote: Verification fit take small time. We go notify you when e done.
tinVerify.educationBody: Correct TIN dey make payment easier, reduce unnecessary withholding, and help clients approve your invoice faster.

vatSetup.title: VAT Setup
vatSetup.exemptTitle: Good news — you no need file VAT return!
vatSetup.exemptBody: If your business dey below 100 million naira, you no need submit VAT return. But you still need collect 7.5% VAT for invoice.
vatSetup.requiredBody: Your business must file VAT return before 21st of every month.

einvoice.title: E-Invoice — New Law
einvoice.phaseSmall: This one no dey compulsory for your business size until 2027. But if you start now, bank fit trust your records more.
einvoice.phaseMedium: Pilot phase don start. E go compulsory by July 1 2026. Apply for FIRSMBS integration now.
einvoice.phaseLarge: ⚠️ E-INVOICE DON BECOME LAW. If you no comply, NRS fit fine you.
einvoice.platform: Na FIRSMBS (NRS Merchant-Buyer Solution) dem dey use

community.title: Join Our Community
community.body: Join plenty Nigerian business owners. Share your badge and collect referral reward.

onboarding.tinRequiredBody: Put correct TIN before you continue.

loading.title: We dey prepare your dashboard
loading.body: We dey load your business profile and compliance snapshot.

resumeSetup.title: Finish your guided setup
resumeSetup.body: Complete small setup make we fit show clearer tax nudges and better compliance guidance.
resumeSetup.fallbackBody: We show safe dashboard view. Continue guided setup make your full personalised experience come back.

emptyState.title: You don start well
emptyState.body: No urgent nudge for now. Check your obligations below or open invoices make your records stay complete.

shield.label: Protected
shield.excellent: 🛡️ Your shield dey strong! Keep am up!
shield.needsWork: You need do some things to protect your business

missingTin.title: Verify your TIN
missingTin.body: If TIN no dey, dem fit cut 10% from every payment wey enter your business.

vatRequired.title: VAT setup needed
vatRequired.body: Your turnover don pass ₦25M threshold, so VAT registration and charging should dey active.

citZero.title: You qualify for 0% Company Tax
citZero.body: Small company relief dey apply, so your current CIT rate na 0%.

vatExempt.title: VAT return filing exemption
vatExempt.body: Your turnover dey under ₦100M, so monthly VAT filing no compulsory for now.

einvoiceReadiness.title: Prepare for e-invoicing
einvoiceReadiness.body: Banks and bigger clients dey move faster when your invoice process don ready for e-invoice.

tin.missing: No TIN → dem go cut 10% from ALL your income

vat.exemption: You fit be exempt from filing VAT return

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.featureBody: Make invoice wey NRS go approve, keep am offline, then sync am later.
